Some introductory and overview materials about the methods are collected here. The selected materials give a good basis to prepare students for their lectures on various methods. However they are not intended as a complete survey of the subject and there is more material in those sections. Some chapters on specific methods ( Hermite and Stochastic Galeriqn methods) are supplemented by practical exercises, containing numerical problems for students in RSI group and LSI (non-RSI students). RSI students are welcome if needed to use any computer
